sources.title: Helios Linux installation and workflow
sources.locator: What it does; Install; Sign in; Where your data lives
sources.finding: Documents a Python GTK4/libadwaita Linux desktop, Ubuntu26.04 amd64 package and other-distro source setup, local sessions, optional worktrees and external coding-agent accounts.

sources.title: Current Helios user guide
sources.locator: First run; Works/goals/plans; Changes pane; Settings; Troubleshooting
sources.finding: Documents session discovery, native provider context, bounded cross-provider handoff, opt-in worktrees, manual goals, actual hunk review, stage/commit/push/PR controls, and provider-native subagent dock. Stable APT can lag this guide.

sources.title: Claude Code executable resolution
sources.finding: Finds the actual installed claude binary using an override, PATH or known native installation locations; it does not substitute a generic Anthropic API endpoint.

sources.title: Actual Codex App Server launch
sources.finding: Spawns the resolved codex binary with app-server and exchanges bidirectional JSON-RPC/stdio; the native runtime owns authentication.

sources.title: Antigravity adapter documentation
sources.finding: Explicitly runs agy Antigravity, discovers models with agy models and uses native Google sign-in. Separate Gemini CLI is not a fallback; worktrees are not credential/service isolation.

sources.title: Local trust and credential boundary
sources.locator: What Helios does with credentials and data; Permissions are not a sandbox; No telemetry
sources.finding: Describes provider-dependent native permission/sandbox modes, environment filtering with exceptions and SSH-agent access. Claims no telemetry but describes a title-generation default that differs from the current guide; neither is a traffic audit.

sources.title: Vendor Git-review interface original
sources.locator: Native1080x494 PNG; Changes pane; tasks.py title validation patch
sources.finding: Exact original pixels show actual removed/added tasks.py code, a title.strip() change and ValueError validation, with a staged-file Unstage control. It is a vendor-staged renderer demo, not a measured live coding result.

sources.title: Helios source change history
sources.finding: The source notes explicitly remove the optional Helios Router broker, which the notes say never dispatched work. Native provider subagents and the OpenRouter chat provider remain distinct.

sources.title: Application source license
sources.finding: The named Helios application source is MIT licensed.
